description: Hallucinogenic compounds expanded the repertoire of connectome harmonic modes, increasing spectral diversity and shifting the distribution of modes toward power laws (Atasoy et al. 2017, as reported by Safron).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Safron 2020. The original study is not read here. Power laws as a mark of criticality are contested, by his account.

sources.quote: hallucinogenic compounds expanded the repertoire of these harmonic modes (Atasoy et al., 2017), increasing spectral diversity
